After 13 years of waiting finally we played gta 6 you would think that i'm happy about this game but i'm not and here is some reasons why:
1- the frame rate is not good at all in this game my eyes hurt when i played it.
2- the story is not intersting at all and has some flaws.
3- the two main characters jason and lucia are the least favorite main characters in all gta series, especially jason he is a the worst in my opinion.
Some people would say 0 out of 10 over reacting and i think it's not cuz we waited for a long time for this game and we paid $100 to play it and they didn't care to gave us the most importnat thing in games "fun".
